Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this rock climbing wall will be big! And, best of all, it'll be built of all-natural, an 100% organic, free-range yard trimmings!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So is it only rock climbing wall?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's not only rock climbing wall. It's free-range organic rock climbing wall!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can see how that would be relevant if we are going to eat it. We are not going to have to eat it, are we?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess if we had to we could...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Did I hear we're building something we can eat?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, for the record, I would like to not be in a position today, where I have to eat this wall.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll see what we can do, but we're not making any promises.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, have you seen my other white skirt? (Looks at the list) What are those charts?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, the rare and elusive, bent-bill knot-hatch is in it's nest building season. The birds will be done traveling North, and should be right here in town today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Snores-ville.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No dear, the bird took a left at Snores-ville, and is up here in Danville. Can I get up high? (Candace high-fives Lawrence)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Woo! Okay, more specifically, it should be right in our backyard at exactly four today! Isn't that exciting!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait wait wait wait wait! So you and a bunch of trained observers are going to be in our yard at exactly four in the P.M. today?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Love it! The Booby-hatched trash-nut whatever it is, is my new favorite bird! This is awesome, see you guys later.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (To Lawrence) See? She thinks it's fun.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes and I'm British, and so you think I'm supposed to like bird watching. (Imitating a British accent) Oh, I'm British, so I'll in the conservatory with tea and a crumpet. I'm saying that ironically but actually that sounds quite good. So I'm going to do that. Ta.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (outside in the backyard) Oh yeah. Yeah. This looks good. So how long 'till you're done with this contraption? Think you'll still be out here at four?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. I guess so.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sadly) Hi Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Isabella, rock climbing wall.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I just came by to tell you that I can't join in on the fun today. I've been charge of the task of recording the audio book version of the Fireside Girls Compendium Guide, it's gonna take forever.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That book does not look so intimidating.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Dude! This is just the table of contents. The actual book is being transported from a secret bunker to a recording studio at the Fireside Girls Lodge. (The book is seen being air-lifted into the lodge) Seriously, this is going to take me a week.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, we can help. We'll just put this rock climbing wall off 'till tomorrow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. What? No! You guys keep working, I'll narrate the audiobook. (To Isabella) You stay here and help the boys. Not only will I finish recording your book today, I'll do it by four o'clock.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, let me get this straight; You'll do all the work, while I spend the day with Phineas? Mmm.... Deal. But do you know anyone who can work a state-of-the-art soundboard? Someone who can edit huge digital files? Someone who can understand basic mic-ing techniques?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (annoyed) What is it, Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Okay, I'll do it. But only if Isabella says "where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: No deal.

Name: Irving
Dialog: You drive a hard bargain, I admit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's okay, I was about to ask that anyway!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. we're getting reports that there is a distinct smell of confectioner sugar, and icing coming form Doofenshmirtz's building. He must be up to something evil and sweet. Sweet and evil. "Sweevil" if you will. Go and stop him.

Name: Irving
Dialog: ...and put your headphones on. Fireside Girls Compendium, page one, and take one. Whenever you're ready.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma May Me Mo Mu. Topeka, Kansas. Topeka, Kansas. (Cut to reveal those are the actual words printed in the book.) Man this is the worst book dedication ever. How we doing in there Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Levels are fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Page one. Welcome Fireside girl. You're about to embark on a trans-formative journey that you will remember for years to come. (Later) ...and water should be boiled. Now on to part two of the introduction. (Later still) (hoarsely) Section 12, part 6. How to start a fire using only bobby pins and a hat. (Even later) Section 25, part 16. How to tell if a marshmallow is properly roasted. (Candace stumbles, and coughs dryly.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Can I get you some water?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe. (She glances at the clock) N-Keep it rolling, keep it rolling. (She continues) Beginning Section 25, part 17.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, gang. Is everybody all strapped into their harness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ready! But it is also the worst wedgie I have ever had.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh really?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Present company excluded.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All righty then. Let's go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why if it isn't Perry the Platypus. And when I say "isn't" I mean "is". I know you're into martial arts. But I prefer the confectionery arts myself. (A gingerbread house falls on Perry) Gingerbread house trap. (Peeking through a window in the house)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey it looks a lot bigger on the inside than it does on the outside. Here, have some cozy gumdrop slippers. Hehehe. Now where was I? Oh yeah. I think I know why I'm having a hard time taking over the Tri-State Area It's because of dinner parties. Follow me, it goes somewhere. You see my brother Roger is a success, because of his amazing dinner parties, where he dazzles important guests, with his magnetic charm. But what if he were unable to charm anyone, because his fabulous dinner parties were over, before they began!? That's why I created this

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How about a banana split? (He shove a banana split down Perry's bill) Haha! Finally got your just desserts. What are you doing with that pound cake? I was saving that for company! (Perry forces Doofenshmirtz to eat the entire pound cake) Oh! Oh wow! Perry the Platypus, I'm getting such a sugar rush! How 'bout you? (Perry is shown to be having a sugar rush as well)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a hoarse voice) In conclusion, may your Fireside Girl experience be a treasured one with memories for a lifetime. The end.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Umm... I'd like you to do one more take on that last chapter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'd like to hurt you.

Name: Irving
Dialog: That's a wrap!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey guys! I can see my thoughts! They're all sparkly and spread out around us.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is the lack of oxygen; it makes you light-headed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think it's time to climb down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha-ha, coming down!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh I get it, we're in space. AAAAAGHAAGH! I heard that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you do this, Perry the Platypus? Can you jump really fast, up and down, up and down, up and down, up and down? Yeah, that's it, Perry the Platypus! Doesn't it feel good? Let's be jumping buddies. Let's just eat dessert and jump up and down and up and down and up and down all day. It'll be our thing. Just remember

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the backyard) Yes! it's still here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace! How'd it go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I finished recording, Irving's uploading it to the Fireside Girl mainframe as we speak

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks so much Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Now the important thing to get Mom out here. (Hoarsely and quietly she yells) Mom! Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you want me to get Mom?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No. You stay here. Nobody move. If we leave, this thing'll disappear. She'll be out here in two minutes, with her bird watching group. I'll wait.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. (Doofenshmirtz collapses) Aww. Oh, sugar crash. (The -inator starts beeping) Oh! The Bring-out-the-Dessert-inator it must be almost time for Roger's dinner party to begin. (Doofenshmirtz sees Perry on the floor) Haha! Sugar crash! (The -inator launches) There she goes! And you can't do anything about it, because you're on a sugar crash. (Perry takes a plate of food out from under his hat.) Wait! Wait, what is that? Protein, and carbohydrates? No, well don't eat that! (Perry does so anyway) No! (Perry chases after the -inator on his jetpack) Okay, but, but let's do that jumping thing again sometime.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (To her bird watching group) Okay gang, everyone follow me outside. The bird should be right-- (Linda gets hit with the -inator) Hey, who's ready for dessert? Doesn't that sound good?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, see now? Brits like dessert.

Name: Bird Watcher Male
Dialog: Does this mean she wants us to leave?

Name: Bird Watcher Female
Dialog: Well according to social convention, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Welcome Perry the Platypus. What took you so long? I'm speaking to you through this amplifier right next to the self destruct button. The rocket will soon be in orbit around my brother's house, ready for the next dinner party. And you can ride that rocket until your tail falls off, I don't care. Or until you find the self destruct button which is right next to (Perry presses the button) Aw, dang it! Curse you Perry the Plat-- (The -inator explodes) ...typus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (She takes out her cellphone and calls Linda)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Come outside!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, I can't here you. Let's talk in a minute. (She hangs up) Who wants this a la mode?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (She runs inside)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! Ooh! It the rare bent-bill knot-hatch! Isn't she beautiful? (The bird begins to pick at the rock climbing wall) She's finding material for her nest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess they've got a lot of nests to make. We did build the thing out of pressed twigs and lawn clippings.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Nature's little recyclers at work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Seeing the rock climbing wall has gone) What? What? No! But, but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, I see it! (The rare bent-bill knot-hatch is shown to be on top of Candace's head) Don't move. Hold still. (Linda takes a picture) Got it! Oh, Candace, I wouldn't have seen it, if you hadn't grabbed my forcibly, and pulled me out here. Thank you! So, you kids want some dessert?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Some tea with honey would help that throat. And, there's crumpets in the conservatory as well. (He walks off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's so British.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's go!
